root_cause: The canonical GitHub OIDC deploy bridge authenticated GitHub correctly but depended on a persisted short-lived Netlify MCP proxy. Once that proxy expired, exact-main production deployment failed with repeated 401 responses; after fail-fast preflight was added, the same stale authority correctly surfaced earlier as bridge unavailable.

prevention.authority: Acquire Netlify deployment authority just in time through the existing Composio connected account on every bridge invocation.
prevention.persistence: Never persist or reuse an issued Netlify MCP proxy in Vault, GitHub secrets or repository source.
prevention.scope: Keep GitHub OIDC restricted to the Bedrijfsgeheugen repository, refs/heads/main and the canonical production-source-snapshot workflow.
prevention.fail_closed: If Vault cannot supply the Composio project key, Composio cannot issue fresh provider authority, or proxy issuance is malformed, fail before deployment with explicit bridge error semantics.

historical_replay: Production Source Snapshot run 37659229217 reached exact-source deployment and received Netlify 401 Unauthorized three times.
The bridge-level credential preflight converted the hidden stale-proxy failure into an earlier 503 bridge failure rather than forwarding invalid authority.
canary: Supabase Vault contains COMPOSIO_API_KEY metadata and the live bridge now resolves authority from that stable secret name.
Supabase Edge Function netlify-deploy-bridge version 15 is active with just-in-time Composio authority acquisition.

runtime: No persisted netlify_mcp_proxy_current or dated proxy lookup in the JIT bridge source
